title: Embed the universe visualizer and add it to the CV
body:
Adds a Projects entry and a dedicated page embedding the independently hosted universe visualizer. Application code, catalogues, textures, and deployment stay in acilione/universe_visualizer.

Adds Universe Visualizer to the canonical Markdown CV, website CV, and Markdown/PDF downloads. Data engineering projects remain first. Condensed three project bullets to retain all seven projects within two pages at the original font size and single-column layout.

Validation: production build; four CV tests; PDF checks for two A4 pages, 53 text blocks in reading order, 11 link annotations, accessible structure, and no images or clipped text; visual inspection of both PDF pages; seven-page browser checks including both CV downloads. Independent atlas: 176 unit tests, browser checks, and successful Pages deployment.

Based on fix/plain-website-copy (PR #2). Merge #2 first, then retarget this PR to main.
